known_limitations: DOCX -> PDF -> DOCX round-trip is lossless only for PDFs created by this application.
Word to PDF uses LibreOffice automatically when available and falls back to Basic Text generation otherwise.
Office-to-PDF is Basic Text conversion unless a layout-preserving engine is configured and validated.
Stamp PDF adds a visible stamp only; it is not certificate-backed digital signing.
Translate PDF, AI Summarizer, PDF/A validation, and real digital signatures are intentionally marked Coming Soon until their engines are implemented and validated.
